conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Hello, I’d like to ask you some questions about your food intake habits.How many cups tea and coffe in a day?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Sure, please go ahead. I drink tea 2 cups

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: How many major meals do you usually have in a day?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I usually have three major meals.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Do you also take snacks between meals?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Yes, I take two snacks per day.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Alright. Which meal do you most often skip or miss in a day?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: I tend to skip breakfast when I’m busy.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Understood. And how many meals do you usually eat together with your family?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Normally one meal a day, usually dinner.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: Do you eat meals while watching TV?

conversation.speaker: patient
conversation.message: Sometimes, about one meal per day.

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: How would you rate the taste of your meals on a scale of 0 to 10?

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: And what about satiety, how filling are your meals on the same scale?

conversation.speaker: doctor
conversation.message: That gives me a good picture of your eating habits. Thank you.
